3.Description: A once peaceful village, thrown into chaos by the invading demons.

5.Description: Strange looking beasts that are working alongside the demons have attacked a small farm settlement. Save the settlers and rid the settlement of its invaders.

7.Description: A shadowy figure has been spotted flying through the ruins of the village. Investigate the strange apparition.

9.Description: Ranhorn, the greatest city in Esperia, known to all as the "Beacon of Justice" has already fallen into Hypogean hands. The Hypogeans now proudly fly their flags atop the city's castle as they pillage and plunder. The city's future now lies with Hogan, the "Knight of the Empire" to once again bring order to chaos that has befallen his homeland.

12.Description: Hogan and his men have fought long and hard to breach the city walls, however they now face Kane, commander of the Hypogean legions. The odds are stacked against the valiant heroes, but Hogan is duty-bound and he must reclaim the city, no matter the cost.
